verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs show that queries can include metadata filter expressions with structured operators such as eq, in, gt and logical and, so results are limited to matching records. One community comment praises its "handling of filtering." Nothing in the pack addresses the story's key condition that filtering does not degrade recall or latency. Missing for 10: evidence on filtered-search recall and latency, independent benchmarks or hands-on reports of filtered queries at scale, and detail on the full operator set and filter behavior.
